title: 第126章 就这，也敢叫帅？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 炎文帝看着这一幕，人都麻了。混账东西，朕让你上去随便玩，意思是让你去拖延点时间，给朕的大军合围创造更好的机会和条件。朕早就布置好了一切，人马已经埋伏在外面，你随便溜溜就能捞一个大功劳。这样朕到时候赏赐的时候，也不会有人敢说什么。但你是不是对随便两个字有什么误会？你这随便过头了知道吗？“这兔崽子，朕想打死他……”炎文帝气得想要打人。龙斩却误会了，以为这是炎文帝让唐逸拖延时间，笑得更加玩味了。今日他们敢出现，会害怕这是炎文帝的阴谋吗？在绝对的实力面前，一切阴谋诡计都是徒劳！因此此时站在桥上的唐逸，在龙斩和暗京楼一众杀手的眼中，不过是一个跳梁小丑罢了！“来来来，小诗仙，让我们看看你这一刀，能有多帅！”“最好能帅到一刀杀死我们全部，不然，游戏可就结束了。”龙斩冲着唐逸勾手，让他快动手，暗京楼一群杀手也都在起哄。“来，小子，老子伸着脖子给你砍。”“出刀吧，让我们看看，你的刀能有多快。”“哈哈，在一群玩刀的人面前玩刀，小子你太嫩了。”“……”嘲讽声席卷全场，唐逸站在桥上没有动静，他身后的一群人脸却都绿了。特别是宁川苏狂和一众锦衣卫，连掐死唐逸的心都有了。本来人家就瞧不上我们锦衣卫，现在好了，都知道锦衣卫里有个白痴了！就连刚刚点了引线的萧棣，此时脸皮也都直抽抽。喂，你悠着点啊，别玩得太过火，等下没办法收场。虽然你说你的秘密武器很牛逼，可那只是你的一面之词，要是等下神秘武器威力没有你所说的那么大，那可就完蛋了。“哥哥，我相信你，打他们。”唐音挥动着小拳头，大声说道。全场也就只有她无条件相信哥哥了。哥哥说这一刀会很帅，那就一定很帅。哼，不接受反驳！“咳，小子，既然他们这么要求，你也别客气了……”炎文帝面色僵硬，唐音都这么说了，小女孩的面子得给。就是唐逸要是收拾不了暗京楼，今日他这皇帝的脸就丢大了。“好，看哥哥一刀破万军。”唐逸轻笑。他也没有再废话，在所有人的注视下，反手一刀劈了出去。桥对面足足埋了上百斤烈性炸药，萧棣已经点火了，虽然引线足够长，但全部燃烧也不过一分钟左右。他得配合爆炸挥刀，才能展现出这帅气一刀的威力。不然爆炸了，他的刀没挥出去算怎么回事？唰！绣春刀在空中一扫而过。然而。什么都没发生。唯独站在桥头上的少年，拎着刀潇洒转身走了。边走边收刀入鞘，脚步从容，神态自如，仿佛那随手挥出的一刀，真的已经一刀破万军，杀得血流成河了。看着这一幕，全场一片死寂。所有人都死死盯着唐逸，脸色都震惊而诡异，这就是你最帅气的一刀？所以，你铺垫这么久，嚣张了这么长时间，你就给我们看这个？！满朝文武和世家豪族都给整破防了，那可是事关我们性命的大事，能不能靠谱点了？“唐逸，你拿我们所有人的命来嘚瑟呢？”“陛下，这就是你找的人？这就是你说的能灭暗京楼的人？”“该死的小子，老夫和你势不两立！”“……”暗京楼那边还在错愕中，百官和世家大族彻底不爽了，纷纷向炎文帝声讨唐逸。唐逸这操作显然会激怒暗京楼，原本他们只需要交赎金就可以活命的，现在真得和炎文帝一起死了。炎文帝也是面色尴尬，朕说这是误会，你们信吗？朕也没想到这小子竟然会这么解决啊，朕让他去掰扯，他全程都在拉仇恨……炎文帝看着咬牙切齿的宁川和锦衣卫众人，面色虽然努力维持平静，但心却在一阵阵抽搐，这家伙不仅拉暗京楼的仇恨，连自己人的仇恨都没放过。简直无敌了！朕现在能咋办？朕也很绝望。“诸位爱卿放心，这是唐逸的策略，他还有后手……”心头骂娘了，炎文帝脸上却装得很平静，一副一切尽在掌控中的样子。众人一听，气得差点当场跳脚，后手？呵呵，他有个屁的后手。现在暗京楼要杀过来了，他的后手能杀死暗京楼这么多人，糊弄谁呢？“刚才谁说这该是咱武将的崽来着？站出来老夫和他聊聊。”连武将这边也破防了，有人忍不住喝问出声。刚才，唐逸将满朝文官压得死死的，算是帮他们出口恶气，让他们觉得唐逸就应该是他们武将的崽。但现在看着这一幕，一群武将怒火中烧，连狄苍等几位和唐逸关系很好的老将，老脸也都在发绿，被唐逸这一刀给气到了。这小子刚才站在舞台上，那是一个嚣张，诗词压得那群文官不敢嘚瑟。但现在这普通的不能再普通的一刀，却被他吹得震天响，让他们这些练家子颜面无光啊！“就这家伙这样子，还想训练我们？老将军你糊涂啊！”“听说陛下已经答应了老将军所奏，都开始从边境将一些将领调回来接受训练了。”“老帅，这小子是在蒙蔽你，你糊涂啊！”“……”原本唐逸一个不会武功的少年，要亲自训练他们这群身经百战的将领，让很多将领都不满，他们在战场拼命的时候，还没这小子呢。现在，一个小兔崽子却告诉他们，仗该怎么打？军队该怎么训练？谁能服？狄苍和几位老将原本挺看好唐逸的，但现在也有点动摇了，觉得让唐逸训练将领的事，是不是真有点草率了？特别是现在被一群后生质疑，更让他们颜面扫地。这时，使团这边秦语和宇文封也都是满脸懵，和使团的人面面相觑，看不懂唐逸到底在干嘛。“呃，这是普普通通的一招吧？就和小孩子过家家一样……”有高手冷笑，忍不住嘲讽。使团一群人看向唐逸，也都面容戏谑。就这？也敢叫帅？我们随便玩个剑花，都能比你帅上千万倍。
content_en: Emperor Yanwen looked at this scene and felt numb.You bastard, I let you go up and play as you please. I mean I want you to delay some time and create better opportunities and conditions for my army to encircle you.I have arranged everything a long time ago. The troops are already ambushing outside. You can get a big credit by just sneaking around.In this way, when I reward you, no one will dare to say anything.But do you have any misunderstanding about the word "random"?Do you know how casual you are?"This bastard, I want to beat him to death..." Emperor Yanwen was so angry that he wanted to beat him.Long Zhan misunderstood, thinking that Emperor Yanwen was asking Tang Yi to delay, and laughed even more playfully.If they dare to show up today, will they be afraid that this is Emperor Yanwen's conspiracy?In the face of absolute strength, all conspiracies and tricks are in vain!Therefore, Tang Yi, who was standing on the bridge at this time, was nothing more than a clown in the eyes of Long Zhan and the killers from Anjing Tower!"Come on, little Shixian, let's see how handsome you can be with this sword!" "It's better to be handsome enough to kill us all with one sword, otherwise, the game will be over." Long Zhan hooked his hand at Tang Yi, telling him to do it quickly, and a group of assassins in Anjing Tower were also booing."Come on, kid, I'll stick out my neck to chop you." "Come on, let's see how fast your knife can be." "Haha, you're too young to play with a knife in front of a group of people who are playing with knives." "..." Ridicule swept the audience. Tang Yi stood motionless on the bridge, but the faces of the group of people behind him turned green.Especially Ningchuan Su Kuang and all the Jinyi guards, they even wanted to strangle Tang Yi to death.Originally, people looked down upon our Jinyiwei, but now everyone knows that there is an idiot in Jinyiwei!Even Xiao Di, who had just clicked on the lead, was twitching at this moment.Hey, take it easy, don't go too far, you won't be able to end it later.Although you said that your secret weapon is awesome, that is only your one-sided statement. If the power of the mysterious weapon is not as powerful as you said, it will be over."Brother, I believe you, beat them." Tang Yin waved his fist and said loudly.She was the only one in the audience who believed in her brother unconditionally.My brother said that this sword would be very handsome, so it must be very handsome.Humph, I won’t accept refutation!"Ahem, boy, since they ask for it, don't be polite..." Emperor Yan Wen's face was stiff, Tang Yin said so, and the little girl had to save her face.If Tang Yi couldn't clean up the Anjing Tower, he would be in great disgrace as the emperor today."Okay, let's see my brother defeat ten thousand armies with one sword." Tang Yi chuckled.He didn't waste any more words, and slashed out with his backhand under everyone's gaze.Hundreds of kilograms of high explosives were buried across the bridge. Xiao Di had already set them on fire. Although the fuse was long enough, it only took about a minute for the whole thing to burn.He had to swing his sword in conjunction with the explosion to show the power of this handsome sword.Otherwise, if there was an explosion, what would happen if his knife didn't swing out?Uh-huh!The embroidered spring knife swept through the air.However.Nothing happened.Only the young man standing on the bridge turned around and walked away with a knife in his hand.She sheathed the sword as she walked, with calm steps and a calm demeanor, as if the sword swung out casually had really cut through thousands of armies and caused rivers of blood to flow.Looking at this scene, the whole place fell into dead silence.Everyone stared at Tang Yi, their expressions were shocked and strange. Is this your most handsome sword?So, you’ve been laying the groundwork and being arrogant for so long, and you’re just going to show us this?!The civil and military officials of the entire dynasty and the wealthy families have all been breached. This is a major matter that affects our lives. Can we be more reliable?"Tang Yi, are you quarreling with all of our lives?" "Your Majesty, this is the person you are looking for? Is this the person you said can destroy Anjing Tower?" "Damn boy, I and you are at odds with each other!" "..." The other side of Anjing Tower was still in shock, and all the officials and aristocratic families were completely unhappy, and they all denounced Tang Yi to Emperor Yanwen.Tang Yi's operation will obviously anger An Jinglou. Originally, they only had to pay a ransom to survive, but now they really have to die together with Emperor Yanwen.Emperor Yanwen also looked embarrassed. I said this was a misunderstanding. Do you believe it?I didn't expect this kid to solve it like this. I asked him to argue. He was seeking hatred the whole time... Emperor Yan Wen looked at Ning Chuan and Jin Yiwei who were gnashing their teeth. Although his expressions were trying to remain calm, his heart was twitching. This guy not only provoked the hatred of An Jinglou, but also the hatred of his own people.Simply invincible!What can I do now?I am also desperate."My dear friends, don't worry. This is Tang Yi's strategy. He has a backup plan..." He cursed in his heart, but Emperor Yan Wen pretended to be calm on his face, as if everything was under control.When everyone heard this, they were so angry that they almost jumped on the spot. What was the second move?Haha, he has a back-up plan.Now Anjinglou is coming to kill him. His backhand can kill so many people in Anjinglou. Who can he fool?"Who said just now that this should be our general's cub? Stand up and have a chat with him." Even the general's defense was broken, and someone couldn't help shouting.Just now, Tang Yi suppressed the civil servants of the Manchu Dynasty, which helped them vent their evil anger and made them think that Tang Yi should be the son of their general.But now looking at this scene, a group of generals were furious. Even Di Cang and several other veterans who had a good relationship with Tang Yi were turning green, angered by Tang Yi's sword.This guy was standing on the stage just now. He was so arrogant, and his poems were so overwhelming that the civil servants didn't dare to complain.But now, this ordinary sword, which was no longer ordinary, was blown up by him, making the practitioners like them lose face!"With this guy like this, he still wants to train us? Old General, you are confused!" "I heard that Your Majesty has agreed to the advice of the old general and has begun to bring some generals back from the border for training." "Old Commander, this boy is trying to deceive you, you are confused!" "..." Originally, Tang Yi, a young man who did not know martial arts, had to personally train them, a group of experienced generals, which made many generals dissatisfied. When they were working hard on the battlefield, this boy was not there.Now, a little brat is telling them how to fight the war?How should the army be trained?Who can accept it?Di Cang and several veterans were originally very optimistic about Tang Yi, but now they are a little shaken. Is it really a bit hasty to let Tang Yi train the generals?Especially now that they are being questioned by a group of young people, it makes them lose face even more.At this time, Qin Yu and Yu Wenfeng on the mission side were also confused. They looked at each other in confusion and couldn't understand what Tang Yi was doing."Well, this is an ordinary move, right?
title_en: Chapter 126 How dare you call him handsome just like this?
